text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English mentions \"Presidential Services Unit\" and \"Federal Chancellery\" as entities with a specific claim about the unit being part of the Chancellery since 2015, while the Italian text refers to \"Servizio presidenziale\" and \"Cancelleria federale\" but does not mention the unit's establishment date or its specific role description as in English.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The Presidential Services Unit, which has been part of the Federal Chancellery since 2015, supports the president’s department in carrying out the additional tasks arising in the presidential year.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "Il servizio presidenziale della Cancelleria federale supporta il dipartimento del presidente nell’adempimento di questi specifici compiti fungendo da consulente per le questioni diplomatiche e concernenti la comunicazione.", "before": "Il servizio presidenziale"}} , "severity"  ,"severity"   ]}
